kashika: करणेऽधिकरणे च कारके धातोर्ल्युट् प्रत्ययो भवति। इध्मप्रव्रश्चनः। पलाशशातनः। अधिकरणे — गोदोहनी। सक्तुधानी॥
kashikaEnglish: ल्युट् for instrument/location: इध्मप्रव्रश्चनः 'wood-cutting axe', गोदोहनी 'milk-pail'. Instrument and locative senses.
englishFull:
करणाधिकरणयोश्च — The affix ल्युट् applies after a root when the word formed is related to the verb as instrument (करण) or location (अधिकरण).

| Example | Relation | Meaning |
|---------|----------|---------|
| इध्मप्रव्रश्चनः | instrument | axe (for cutting wood) |
| गोदोहनी | location | milk-pail (vessel into which milk is milked) |
| सक्तुधानी | location | container for barley-meal |

This affix expresses both instrumental case (tool) and locative case (repository) meanings.
